summary: LoRA adapter v2a epoch2, greedy decoding
hypothesis: A larger fine-tuning corpus (619 total, 558 train pairs) should push the adapter above the in-context plateau, because more diverse examples give the model better judgment about question quality — not just stylistic cues.
technique: A single greedy (deterministic) on-device call using a LoRA adapter (v2a, epoch 2) fine-tuned on 558 train pairs at lr 5e-4, early-stopped. Greedy decoding eliminates the sampling noise that previously masked adapter gains on the full-30 eval.
